item_short_desc: Gear up for your next mission in our Tactical Deployment Pant. With a 6 pocket design, these military cargo pants provide enhanced storage for field operations or everyday use. The 2 pleated side cargo pockets expand when needed for carrying tactical gear, while the 2 rear slit pockets with hook & loop closure and 2 front slash pockets with a utility pocket on the right side for additional EDC storage.
description: Gear up for your next mission in our Tactical Deployment Pant. With a 6 pocket design, these military cargo pants provide enhanced storage for field operations or everyday use. The 2 pleated side cargo pockets expand when needed for carrying tactical gear, while the 2 rear slit pockets with hook & loop closure and 2 front slash pockets with a utility pocket on the right side for additional EDC storage. Exceptional Protection: Engineered with a rugged rip-stop fabric that withstands the strenuous demands of any job, the tactical pants feature a 65% polyester / 35% cotton blend that offers unbeatable durability and all-day comfort. The stain and water-resistant finish repels liquids, dirt, and debris. Tried-and-True Reliability: The tactical pants are reinforced in the seat and knees for maximum durability that endures wear and tear while supporting a full range of motion. The double-stitched seams provide extra strength and years of reliable use. Unrestricted Movement: From an active day at work to a full-on sprint, the comfort slide waistband allows you to move freely with ease. These rip-stop pants are ideal for public safety, security professionals, active-duty personnel, tactical enthusiasts, and more. Utility at the Forefront: These tactical cargo pants feature a zipper fly with a snap-button closure for easy on and off while maintaining a secure fit. The 1 1/2 inch wide belt loops help support the additional weight from well-equipped duty belts.
